text:
The issue is caused by an incorrect API endpoint. The request is currently targeting `https://ollama.com/api`, which returns a `404 Not Found`.

According to the documentation:
* The built-in `ollama-cloud` provider routes to **`https://ollama.com/v1`**.

### Solution
Check your model/provider configuration and ensure the `base_url` is either unset (to let the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider use its default) or explicitly set to:

```yaml
base_url: https://ollama.com/v1
```
